listed_sector_signals.signal: Cited figure for energy consumption reduction potential in US petroleum refineries under a structured energy management system
listed_sector_signals.quote:
For US refineries, it was stated that the energy consumption in the plants could be reduced by 10-20% (Worrell and Galitsky 2005) by following a structured energy
management system

listed_sector_signals.signal: Refinery example of power recovery turbine re-rating on a fluid catalytic cracker
listed_sector_signals.quote:
For a Houston refinery, by re-rating
the power recovery turbine of fluid catalytic cracker it was possible to save 22MW of energy and the plant
was able to export an additional 4MW to the grid (Worrell and Galitsky 2005).

listed_sector_signals.signal: Cited heat-recovery demonstration in a crude oil distillation unit via pump-around optimization
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The work by (Zhang et al. 2013) demonstrated for heat recovery in a crude
oil distillation unit where by optimizing the distribution of pump-around duties resulted in 8.2%
reductions in energy use without any capital expenditure

listed_sector_signals.signal: Statement on share of refinery energy met by steam
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Around 30% of energy use in
refineries is being met by steam (Worrell and Galitsky 2005).

listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference to demonstrated flare gas recovery systems in US refineries
listed_sector_signals.quote:
There
have also been several demonstrations of flare gas recovery systems in refineries in US (Worrell and
Galitsky 2005).

listed_sector_signals.signal: Chemical industry production emissions cited as context for energy efficiency
listed_sector_signals.quote:
the total green-house gas equivalent emissions from the chemical industry
alone is 2.1 GtCO2e which is a significant proportion of the global man-made emissions and of which
two-thirds is from energy-use during production

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Hypothetical EnPI example for an NGL and condensate gas-processing plant
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
the EnPI for an NGL and condensate plant could be ‘MWthermal
consumed / MWthermal of products’

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Flare gas recovery option for a Middle-East plant (GTL) with quantified reductions
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The work by (Saravanan and van Vuuren 2014) provides various options for flare gas recovery for a
plant in the Middle-East. For one of the options, where the flare gas was found suitable to be used in fired
heaters, it reduced flaring from 724, 299 MT per annum to 7, 034 MT per annum.

one_line: A conceptual strategy paper arguing how EPC contractors and operating companies should partner to embed ISO 50001 energy-management requirements into the design and construction of petroleum-industry facilities, drawing on cited refinery/plant examples rather than the authors' own empirical demonstration.
